notes: The breadboard image is drawn with rows j-f at the top, which correspond to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j); holes are named accordingly (e.g. '3b.g').

Orange wire runs from pin 13 to column 3 (row g); the resistor spans column 3 (row h) to column 6 (row h); the LED's long (bent) anode leg is in column 6 (row i) and the short cathode leg in column 8 (row i); the black wire runs from GND to column 8 (row g).
The GND used is the one next to AREF on the digital header, assumed to be GND.1.
The LED and resistor are optional in the manual (many boards have a built-in LED on pin 13); the external circuit is included as requested.
The USB cable to the computer is not drawn in the circuit image and is omitted.
